Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as inner join, join assays on assay_id. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL3705960, standard_relation equals '=', standard_value not null, standard_relation not null. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Return all matching rows without deduplication.
